How to use this calculator

  2. Select Calculate to see the answer and its breakdown.
  3. Keep a scenario, change an input and compare the results.

Use consistent units and check the assumptions below before applying the result.

How mileage is calculated

Compute distance between two odometer readings, optionally subtracting a correction or comparing multiple trips. Enter values in the same distance unit; this tool does not infer a route or account for GPS/odometer calibration. Odometer readings of 12,340 and 12,615 miles show 275 miles traveled. The calculation validates each input and keeps its stated units explicit. Enter the rollover modulus or calculate the segments separately; a negative result is rejected. This is an estimate for the stated assumptions; confirm measurements and any applicable professional or local standards before relying on it.

Mileage Calculator is calculated from the supplied measurement fields using the units shown.
A worked example

Odometer readings of 12,340 and 12,615 miles show 275 miles traveled.

Assumptions & useful context

The result depends on the values you enter and the method described above. Displayed numbers may be rounded; calculations use the unrounded values. Check that this model matches your situation before relying on it.

Frequently asked questions

What if the odometer rolled over?

Enter the rollover modulus or calculate the segments separately; a negative result is rejected.

Does it map a route?

No. It calculates from the values you provide.
